note: Second upstairs shapes studio (floorboards). Feminine nouns on the left (la forme, la ligne, la pointe, la surface); masculine on the right (le point, le bord, le coin, le symbole, le trait, le cercle). Zooms: the chalkboard ledge (back wall, centre) and the school desk (right wall). Left blue door back to the first shapes room; the glazed door on the right opens onto the landing of the outside staircase, which goes down to the yard in front of the workshop.
